svg.text: CPC: strong future retrieval does not imply a complete state
Two complementary tests: what a linear probe recovers, and whether context identifies a future latent
Top-1 retrieval (top-5 is 100% at all horizons)
State-probe values are mean ± SD across five CPC training seeds; right-panel error bars show SD across the same seeds.
The query-weighted in-batch chance level for top-1 retrieval is 3.5%. These are retrieval metrics, not physical-state prediction accuracy.
